Selected work

Work we're proud to show.

We'd rather show you two real engagements, honestly described, than a wall of logos and numbers nobody can verify. Here's what we actually do, day to day.

Travel tech · Ongoing partnership

TravelIQ

An AI travel companion, brought to life. TravelIQ is a voice-AI travel platform, and Beeancy is its creative and marketing engine. We build its futuristic, AI-first presence end to end — and because the partnership is ongoing, the work keeps evolving with the product.

  • Brand & content direction — a distinctive AI-futuristic identity, applied consistently across every touchpoint
  • AI-generated video & social content — produced on a weekly rhythm, blending human creative direction with AI production speed
  • Voice AI experience — a conversational assistant that answers trip questions in real time, in the brand's voice
  • Web presence — designed and built for performance and conversion

What we'd tell a prospect: this is what a long-term, human-led, AI-powered partnership looks like in practice.

Specialist tour operator · Paid media

Niche Tour Operator

Seasonal campaigns that respect the booking window. For a specialist tour operator selling considered, high-value trips, we run the full paid journey — from media plan to landing page.

  • Media buying — channel planning and budget split across Meta and Google, weighted to peak booking windows rather than flat monthly spend
  • Advertising — creative and copy refreshed for each seasonal campaign window, with structured A/B testing
  • Landing pages & tracking — built to convert and measured on enquiry quality, not just clicks

We measure this engagement on enquiries, bookings and cost per booking — and report those numbers to the client, not the internet.
